# ai-ulu — Shipcraft

> Shipcraft is the web and app studio of ai-ulu, run by Ali Ulu. It designs, builds and launches cinematic websites and custom web apps, and supports them after launch. Languages: English and Turkish.

## What we do
- Websites: brand and marketing sites with art direction and motion
- Apps: custom web apps, dashboards, internal tools
- Site + App under one design system

## Work
- Attalia (group site), Hercules Investments (https://herculesinvestmentsllc.com), Hydrelon (https://hydrelon.com)
- Starter templates: aesthetic clinic, restaurant, law firm, architecture studio, fitness studio (https://ai-ulu.com/templates/)
